outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative spatial transcriptomics cluster image of a single SNL lung section (no quantitative summary or error bars shown).
Panel B shows representative H&E images and manual annotation of the same lung section (no reported replicated quantitative data).
Panel C presents annotated images and spatial mRNA distribution plots for the lung section (representative images rather than summarized replicated data).

GSEA compares T11b-high versus low (S1&S2 versus S3) and reports NES/FDR/P and 1000 permutations, but the figure legend does not state the number or type of biological/technical replicates or samples used for the analysis.

Panel E shows a bar graph of differential gene expression with P values but the legend does not report the number of replicates (n) or specify what the replicates represent (e.g., spots, tumors, animals, independent experiments).
